name: FastAPI
covers: Rerail's own FastAPI rules, from the FastAPI docs and maintainers' review advice, for safe dependencies, response models and async endpoints.

rules.title: FastAPI practice: CORSMiddleware allows every origin together with allow_credentials=True

caught.text:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

app = FastAPI()
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

passes.text:

    allow_origins=["https://app.example.com"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],

rules.title: FastAPI practice: an httpx or aiohttp client built per request, in a route, dependency or middleware or a helper they call

caught.text:
import httpx
from fastapi import FastAPI

app = FastAPI()


@app.get("/weather")
async def weather(city: str):
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=5) as client:
        resp = await client.get("https://api.example.com/weather", params={"city": city})
    return resp.json()

passes.text:
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

import httpx
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=5) as client:
        app.state.http = client
        yield


app = FastAPI(lifespan=lifespan)


@app.get("/weather")
async def weather(request: Request, city: str):
    resp = await request.app.state.http.get("https://api.example.com/weather", params={"city": city})
    return resp.json()

from collections.abc import AsyncIterator

rules.title: FastAPI practice: the request's database session handed to a background task, which runs after its dependency or middleware has closed it

with.text: # empty module

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=create_engine("postgresql://localhost/app"))


def get_db():
    with SessionLocal() as db:
        yield db
        db.commit()

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from .db import SessionLocal


def send_report(db: Session, user_id: int) -> None:
    db.execute("UPDATE reports SET sent = true WHERE user_id = :id", {"id": user_id})
    db.commit()


def send_report_by_id(user_id: int) -> None:
    with SessionLocal() as db:
        send_report(db, user_id)

rules.title: FastAPI practice: a route's response sends a password hash, key or secret field to clients
FastAPI practice: one route of a router leaves out the auth dependency every other route requires
FastAPI practice: an earlier route of the same router answers this route's paths first
FastAPI practice: blocking sync SQLAlchemy session work in an `async def` route, dependency or middleware, written there or reached through sync helpers

caught.text:
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends

from .crud import get_users
from .db import get_db

router = APIRouter()


@router.get("/users")
async def list_users(db=Depends(get_db)):
    return get_users(db)

rules.title: FastAPI practice: a yield dependency releases its connection outside finally, or swallows the route's error

caught.text:
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

engine = create_engine("postgresql://localhost/app")
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine)


def get_db():
    db = SessionLocal()
    yield db
    db.close()
